steps.description: Record both current additive directions and shared architecture; neither supersedes the other. This plan does not reorder or abandon existing obligations.
Complete creator Stage A dependency/feasibility decisions and define the first real-footage acceptance scenario; no editor implementation or rendering in Stage A.
Define a separately bounded FOOD draft-domain slice with explicit unknown/pending evidence and no sale authority. Implementation is proposed, not authorized here.
When separately scoped, develop the constrained creator workflow with reversible plans and downloadable exports; evaluate local worker integration before selecting dependencies.
When separately scoped and external readiness is resolved, add food operational persistence/access, then reviewed ordering/payments/personal fulfillment, then reconciliation and CPA exports.

Add retention/shared food content, then verified partner/community reporting, then anonymized education. Recorded-player improvements, automation and optional livestreaming have separate acceptance criteria.

acceptanceCriteria: Both handoffs have explicit source, current direction status, current-versus-future distinction, and mutual non-supersession.
Shared infrastructure and missing capabilities are mapped without claiming production readiness or duplicating subsystem authority.
Creator Stage A and the proposed pure food draft slice have bounded completion criteria; external decisions remain unknown/pending rather than invented approvals.
Only the four planning files are created, JSON parses, Markdown structure/local links validate, and whitespace checks pass.
approvalBoundaries: No product implementation, dependencies, routes, schemas, migrations, persistence, checkout, Stripe changes, rendering, public counters, livestreaming, food products or production data.
No deploy, provider activation, contact execution, secrets access, legal/tax approval inference, or external financial commitment.
Stop before staging, commit or push. Future implementation needs separately bounded instructions; this plan supplies no execution authority.
dependencyClarifications: Step numbers organize the planning record, not mandatory cross-track dependencies: creator implementation does not block food planning, draft-domain work or an otherwise lawful food launch.
Creator Stage A precedes creator implementation; the complete cooking workflow precedes general editor/public-platform expansion.
Food legal/tax/water/safety/payment gates apply to food sales activation; community preparation, partner and contribution gates apply only to community activation.

Private draft planning can proceed while external responses are pending. Optional full accounting, advertising, advanced rewards, recipes and fundraising do not become launch prerequisites; adequate interim records remain necessary.
